findings: In pinned MATLAB .m files, setting.L5 selects elevation thresholds for P/D/L (5 degrees if true, 10 otherwise). The direct prm.L5 field is assigned but no direct read was found.
prm.BDS is assigned in parameters.m; no direct read of prm.BDS was found in the pinned MATLAB .m files.
Source exobs.m iterates L1 and L5 whenever present; this function does not exclude a band based on prm.L5 or prm.BDS.
Native explicit route preset maps L5 to elevation thresholds and Type to robust thresholds and GNSS velocity-motion sigma. TDCP Huber changes only with its separate selector.
limitations: Static named-field audit only; dynamic field access and external toolbox behavior are not proved by this search.
No claim that source or native BDS/L5 satellite admission is fully equivalent.
The explicit route comparison changes a preset bundle; it cannot isolate individual parameter impact.
